title: One Extra Screw
style: country folk comedy, 100 BPM, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, harmonica, brush snare, upright bass, warm male storyteller vocal, conversational delivery, hammer tap percussion intro, americana
lyrics:
[Intro — country acoustic, harmonica, hammer tap]
The bookshelf is finished
The instructions said done…

[Verse 1]
I followed every step from page one to fourteen
I cross-referenced the diagrams, kept the workspace clean
I drilled with confidence, I aligned with care
I turned the bookshelf upright and stood it standing there

[Pre-Chorus]
And then on the floor I saw the gleam
Of a single shining screw of medium-length sheen
Where does it go? It must go somewhere
Why else would it ship? It can't ship just in air

[Chorus]
One extra screw! One extra screw!
The bookshelf is standing but I'm staring at you
One extra screw! One extra screw!
Is the cabinet a coffin? What did I miss to do?
One extra screw!

[Verse 2]
I checked every joint, I jiggled every shelf
I shook the whole structure and it stood by itself
Maybe Sweden sends spares, that's the Swedish way
Maybe the screw is symbolic of a meaning I can't say

[Pre-Chorus]
But I cannot trust it now, the bookshelf is cursed
A ticking time-bomb at any minute could burst
Pour books on my children at three in the night
Because somewhere a hidden hole is missing its bite

[Chorus]
One extra screw! One extra screw!
The bookshelf is standing but I'm staring at you
One extra screw! One extra screw!
Is the cabinet a coffin? What did I miss to do?
One extra screw!

[Bridge — harmonica solo, then spoken]
[me] I'm just gonna put it in my pocket.
[partner] Don't put it in your pocket.
[me] Maybe the next bookshelf will need it.
[partner] You're keeping a screw drawer.
[me] Everyone keeps a screw drawer.

[Outro]
One extra screw!
Joins the screw drawer with the eight hundred others
One extra screw!
